Context: 7. Central Administrative Tribunal

21. Any other matters.
3. Filing of application.Normally, only an individual has to file an application (filing fee for each being t 50). More than one person may join together and file a single application, with the permission of the Tribunal, if it is satisfied, having regard to the cause of action and the nature of relief prayed for, that they have a common interest in the matter. A separate application seeking for such permission is required to be filled.
